title: Auscultation Walk
summary: Viktor lends V a stethoscope and asks for honest guesses about three humming machines in the noodle alley.

start.bringUp: Viktor invites V to a listening walk through the noodle alley in Little China, with a stethoscope and a theory.

variations.know: It is raining. The hums are masked, so the guesses are harder.
The listening stops are on the monorail platform instead of the alley.
The last stop is V's own heartbeat after a sprint, which Viktor times on his watch.

alley.name: the noodle alley under the elevated rail in Little China

platform.name: the monorail platform in Little China

hum.name: a humming neon box in the alley

vend.name: a vending machine in the alley

amp.name: a busker's amp at the alley mouth

g1.asks: Which of the three worried you most, and why?
g1.know: The stops, and V's guesses so far.
g1.secret: The vending machine is the one that is actually fine.
g1.wants: V to name a reason, not a hunch.

stages.label: Viktor lends V a stethoscope for three listening stops
stages.know: Viktor is in the noodle alley with a stethoscope. You listen to three humming machines, say what is wrong with each, and tell him the truth. A passer-by with a limp walks past, and Viktor asks you to stop him.
stages.wants: V to hear the three machines and name what is wrong with each.

done.memory: You listened to three humming machines in the noodle alley with Viktor and told him what was wrong with each.

twist.memory: A limping stranger in the noodle alley let you talk him into a check, and Viktor watched you do it.
